<!-- pr-reviewer: f373050c58becdec2a5dcd0082906cd81506b669 -->
**Verdict: Not built - needs a maintainer look.** No blockers found. This PR adds a rule to AGENTS.md (project law), which is the owner's decision, so it waits for a maintainer call. It is docs/process only.

Thanks for this, JSwetz.

**What looks good**
- It matches the rule text proposed in #356 almost word for word: a new user-facing command ships with its MCP tool (and script verb where it fits) in `crates/app/src/mcp/`, or with a `source:agent` follow-up issue "MCP: <command>" named in the PR body. It sits in the "Everything Is a Command" section, and the "follow-up issue" escape hatch keeps it from blocking PRs.
- It touches three files only (`AGENTS.md` +8, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` +122, `docs/decisions/356-commands-mcp-process.md` +16). No code, `build.rs`, `.github/`, scripts or dependencies change.
- The decision ledger is in the per-PR `docs/decisions/` file rather than `RECOMMENDED.md`, as the Autonomous Work Law asks. No `CHANGELOG.md` edit, and the body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #356`.
- The skill is the project skill #356 suggested (workflow, DTO shapes, refusals as data, undo). It has no HSMWorks/Fusion/Autodesk material (grepped).

**Local results**
- Trial merge with `upstream/main`: already up to date, no conflicts.
- Not built: docs only, no code in the diff. The PR's reported results (mcp suite 13/13, check) were not re-run.

**Requested before merge**
None blocking. The maintainer needs to accept or decline the rule itself (#356 is labelled as an owner decision).

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `AGENTS.md:329-336`: the new bullet is the only bullet in a prose section. Consider making it a plain paragraph for consistency.
- The skill's description promises "known gaps", but #356 lists specific open gaps (#180 picking, #181 machine/work offsets, #182 sim render, #312 hole detection). The skill now documents `set_work_offset`, `load_machine` and `detect_holes` as present, so please confirm the tool list matches the current `crates/app/src/mcp/` and say which gaps remain.
- The skill states that handlers "catch panics defensively". The Prime Directive forbids relying on panics, so you may want to reword it as a last-resort guard.
- `SKILL.md` is 122 lines, so no file-size concern.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f29c51deae5c89cc2f79349c14682257dac5b544 -->
**Not built - needs a maintainer look.** This PR edits AGENTS.md (project law), so the owner decides. I found no blockers. It is docs-only, so there was nothing to build.

Thanks for the quick turnaround, JSwetz. All three notes from the last review are addressed.

**What looks good**
- The AGENTS.md addition is now one short paragraph in "Everything Is a Command" (AGENTS.md ~329-334). It has the escape hatch (a `source:agent` `MCP: <command>` follow-up issue named in the PR body), so a command PR is not blocked.
- The panic wording is now "cold, last-resort crash barrier", tied to the Prime Directive. It matches `catch_unwind` at `crates/app/src/mcp/mod.rs:132`.
- Every one of the 34 tools in the SKILL.md table (including `set_work_offset`, `load_machine` and `detect_holes`) is registered in `crates/app/src/mcp/`. I grepped each name against the source.
- "Known Remaining Gaps" is now an explicit numbered list. Each item cites the command module it refers to, and `move_model.rs`, `repair_model.rs`, `set_units.rs`, `program_entry.rs` and `post_options.rs` all exist in `crates/app/src/commands/`.
- The PR touches no `CHANGELOG.md`. The `docs/decisions/356-commands-mcp-process.md` file is in the right place. The body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #356`.

**Local results (trial-merged with current main)**
- The merge was clean, with no conflicts. Only 3 files change: AGENTS.md, the SKILL.md and the decision file.
- No build, test or clippy run, since no code changed. There are no `build.rs`, `.github/`, script or dependency changes.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The tool count "34" and the gaps list will drift as tools land. The SKILL.md could say "see `tools::list()` for the authoritative list". I did not count the registry programmatically; I only checked that each of the 34 names exists.
2. `Fixes #356` closes the issue, but the "Known Remaining Gaps" list implies some follow-up issues. Consider `Refs #356` unless those gaps are filed separately.
3. SKILL.md is 147 lines, under the file-size guideline.
4. The PR is not a draft. It is open as set by its contributor, and I left that unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
